title: "Social Discounting Toolkit: Generate Practice Datasets"
author: "Naomi Nero & Abigail Marsh"

This script creates the two simulated practice datasets used in `Social Discounting Package.Rmd`:

- `SDlongform_exampledata.csv` (original Social Discounting Task)
- `SDshortform_exampledata.csv` (Social Discounting Task: Short Form)

Here, each simulated participant gets their own baseline generosity (`v0`) and discounting rate (`logk`), and their choices are generated from the hyperbolic model with response noise. 

The datasets contain no real participant data. Running this script with the same seed always produces the same files.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
```

# Settings

```{r settings}
seed  <- 20261110    # fixed seed: the same files are produced every time
n_sub <- 120         # simulated participants per task version

out_dir    <- "/Users/Documents/Social-Discounting-Manual/"    # folder to save the practice files in (this script's folder)
file_long  <- file.path(out_dir, "SDlongform_exampledata.csv")
file_short <- file.path(out_dir, "SDshortform_exampledata.csv")

D        <- c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100)              # social distances
amt_long <- c(80, 70, 60, 50, 40, 30, 20, 10, 0)     # amount forgone by sharing on trials 1-9

# True-parameter distributions (same as Simulation Validation.Rmd)
# Long form: Nero et al. (2025), N = 715
#   v0 fixed at 86.22 (the v0 random-effect SD was ~0)
#   logk M = -2.04, SD = 2.03, range -5.77 to 1.81 (values outside the range are truncated)
true_long  <- list(v0_mean = 86.22, v0_sd = 0,  v0_min = 86.22, v0_max = 86.22,
                   logk_mean = -2.04, logk_sd = 2.03, logk_min = -5.77, logk_max = 1.81,
                   r_v0_logk = 0)
# Short form: Amormino et al. (2026), replication study, N = 715
#   v0 M = 5.53, SD = 2.35, range 0.28 to 11.06
#   logk M = -3.71, SD = 1.72, range -6.92 to 0.30; r(v0, logk) = .55
true_short <- list(v0_mean = 5.53, v0_sd = 2.35, v0_min = 0.28, v0_max = 11.06,
                   logk_mean = -3.71, logk_sd = 1.72, logk_min = -6.92, logk_max = 0.30,
                   r_v0_logk = 0.55)

# Response noise (the "low" noise level in Simulation Validation.Rmd)
#   long form:  tau = spread of the logistic choice rule; some participants will switch more than once
#   short form: SD of normal noise added before rounding to whole dollars
tau_long       <- 3
sd_noise_short <- 0.5
```

# Data generators


```{r generators}
draw_true <- function(n, s) {
  # correlated standard normal draws for v0 and logk (r = s$r_v0_logk)
  z1 <- rnorm(n)
  z2 <- s$r_v0_logk * z1 + sqrt(1 - s$r_v0_logk^2) * rnorm(n)
  data.frame(subnum = 1:n,
             v0   = pmin(pmax(s$v0_mean   + s$v0_sd   * z1, s$v0_min),   s$v0_max),
             logk = pmin(pmax(s$logk_mean + s$logk_sd * z2, s$logk_min), s$logk_max))
}

# Qualtrics exports have 2 extra rows under the header (question text, ImportId).
# The practice files include them so users see the same format as a real export.
write_qualtrics_csv <- function(df, file) {
  header_rows <- as.data.frame(rbind(
    setNames(rep("Question text", ncol(df)), names(df)),
    setNames(rep('{"ImportId":"QID"}', ncol(df)), names(df))))
  out <- rbind(header_rows, as.data.frame(lapply(df, as.character)))
  write.csv(out, file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
}

# Long form: logistic choice rule around each participant's true amount willing to forgo
sim_long <- function(n, tau) {
  true <- draw_true(n, true_long)
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    vals <- unlist(lapply(D, function(d) {
      V <- true$v0[i] / (1 + exp(true$logk[i]) * d)
      p <- if (tau == 0) as.numeric(amt_long < V) else plogis((V - amt_long) / tau)
      share <- rbinom(9, 1, p)
      val <- ifelse(share == 1, amt_long, 0)   # trials 1-8: 0 = kept, 80..10 = shared
      if (share[9] == 0) val[9] <- -5          # trial 9: -5 = kept, 0 = shared
      setNames(val, paste0("sd", d, "_", 1:9))
    }))
    c(subnum = i, vals)
  })
  list(wide = as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, rows)), true = true)
}

# Short form: give round(V + noise) dollars, limited to 0-10
sim_short <- function(n, sd_noise) {
  true <- draw_true(n, true_short)
  give <- sapply(D, function(d) {
    V <- true$v0 / (1 + exp(true$logk) * d)
    pmin(pmax(round(V + rnorm(n, 0, sd_noise)), 0), 10)
  })
  wide <- data.frame(subnum = 1:n, give)
  names(wide)[-1] <- paste0("X", 1:7, "_SDshort_decision")   # as R reads 1_SDshort_decision
  list(wide = wide, true = true)
}
```

# Generate and save

```{r generate}
set.seed(seed)
long  <- sim_long(n_sub, tau_long)
short <- sim_short(n_sub, sd_noise_short)

write_qualtrics_csv(long$wide,  file_long)
write_qualtrics_csv(short$wide, file_short)

# The true (generating) parameters are saved too, so users can compare them with the toolkit's estimates
write.csv(long$true,  file.path(out_dir, "SDlongform_exampledata_trueparameters.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(short$true, file.path(out_dir, "SDshortform_exampledata_trueparameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Check the generated data

The true parameters should vary across participants, and generosity should decline with social distance.

```{r check}
# True parameters
summary(long$true[, c("v0", "logk")])
summary(short$true[, c("v0", "logk")])

# Long form: number of participants who switch more than once at one or more distances
n_switches <- function(row) {
  sapply(D, function(d) {
    s <- as.numeric(row[paste0("sd", d, "_", 1:9)]) > 0 |
         (seq_len(9) == 9 & as.numeric(row[paste0("sd", d, "_9")]) == 0)
    sum(diff(s) != 0)
  })
}
multi <- apply(long$wide, 1, function(r) any(n_switches(r) > 1))
cat("Long-form participants with more than one switch at any distance:", sum(multi), "of", n_sub, "\n")

# Short form: mean amount given at each social distance
round(colMeans(short$wide[, -1]), 2)
```
